jobs.title: General Manager Publishing and Distribution Technology
jobs.location: NSW - SHS 2 Holt Street Surry Hills
jobs.description:
What's the role?
Lead the digital technology engine behind News Corp Australia’s next chapter

News Corp Australia reaches millions of Australians every day through some of the country’s most recognised media brands. We are looking for an exceptional technology executive to lead the platforms that bring that journalism to audiences across the web, mobile and partner ecosystem.

As General Manager, Publishing & Distribution, you will own the technology strategy, roadmap, delivery and operations for the digital publishing and distribution value stream across approximately 30 brands. This is a rare opportunity to shape the future of digital media in Australia: setting the ambition for world leading web and app experiences while ensuring the platforms behind them are resilient, secure, scalable and commercially focused.

Reporting to the Director of Digital Applications and Capabilities, you will be a senior leader in the Technology, Digital & Data leadership team and a strategic partner to editorial, consumer, product, commercial and enterprise leaders.

The role
You will lead the shared digital capabilities that allow our brands to publish once, distribute intelligently and deliver exceptional experiences across every relevant channel.

Your remit includes the strategy, engineering, delivery and operational performance of:
- Consumer facing websites and mobile applications across News Corp Australia’s portfolio
- Publishing platforms, including WordPress, PHP and associated frontend and platform capabilities
- Content APIs and shared content distribution services
- Digital editions and partner products
- Video and audio publishing and streaming capabilities
- Media and digital asset management (MAM/DAM)
- Digital rights management (DRM)
- Content delivery, syndication and distribution workflows
- Supporting capabilities such as print production integration and push messaging

You will create the conditions for these capabilities to be reused across brands and consumed by product and audience squads through well designed APIs and platforms, rather than repeatedly rebuilt.

What you will do

Set the direction
- Define and execute the Publishing & Distribution technology strategy and multi year roadmap, aligned to audience growth, customer experience, editorial ambition and commercial outcomes
- Establish the standards and investment priorities that will enable our web and app channels to lead the world
- Translate business and publisher strategy into clear technology choices, sequencing and measurable outcomes
- Balance innovation and modernisation with the reliability, security and operational discipline required of high volume publishing platforms

Own delivery and operations
- Hold end to end accountability for delivery, service performance and continuous improvement across the value stream
- Set the right balance between run, change and transformation, protecting uptime and resilience while increasing feature velocity
- Build a culture of engineering excellence, observability, automation, security and learning from incidents
- Make informed trade offs across capacity, cost, risk, quality and time to market
- Measure success through delivered value, platform reliability, capability reuse, squad satisfaction and post go live outcomes

- Lead a high performing value stream in a matrix model, bringing together people from technology practices, centres of excellence, vendors and cross functional squads
- Create clarity across direct, embedded and dotted line relationships so teams can move quickly without losing technical coherence or accountability
- Partner with practice leaders to develop capability, career pathways, engineering standards and succession
- Coach and empower senior leaders, including the Heads of Publishing Technology and Distribution Technology
- Build autonomous, collaborative squads that are accountable for outcomes, not activity

Partner at executive level
- Act as the senior technology partner to editorial, product, audience, commercial and brand leaders
- Represent Publishing & Distribution in portfolio, governance and senior leadership forums
- Shape demand at source through a disciplined front door, clear prioritisation and transparent trade offs
- Coordinate across product and platform squads to maximise reuse and reduce duplication
- Manage strategic vendors, managed service partners and portfolio budgets, including blended internal and external delivery models
- Bring a responsible, governed approach to the use of AI across publishing, distribution and media asset workflows

Who are you?
You are an established digital technology leader who has operated at scale and knows what it takes to run mission critical consumer platforms. You will combine executive presence and commercial judgement with enough technical depth to challenge assumptions, make sound architectural decisions and earn the respect of senior engineers.

You will bring:
- Significant leadership experience in digital technology, ideally across consumer facing web, mobile applications or other high scale digital products
- A track record of leading technology, engineering, product delivery or platform functions in media, publishing, consumer technology or another complex, high-volume environment
- Experience owning technology roadmaps and outcomes across multiple products, brands, business units or markets
- Strong understanding of modern web and app architectures, APIs, CMS platforms and digital content ecosystems
- Experience with platforms such as WordPress/PHP, content APIs, video and audio, MAM/DAM, AWS, DRM, digital editions or partner distribution
- Demonstrated success leading in a matrix or federated operating model, including influence without direct line control
- Operational judgement and experience running resilient, secure, always on services
- Commercial capability across budgets, vendors, managed services, capacity planning and delivery partners
- The ability to lead transformation while maintaining trust with teams and stakeholders
- A coaching mindset, with a genuine commitment to building leaders, developing talent and creating an inclusive, high performing culture

You do not need to be the deepest technical expert in every platform. You do need to be able to connect strategy to architecture, architecture to delivery and delivery to measurable audience and business value.

jobs.location: VIC - SBK HWT Tower 40 City Road Southbank
jobs.description:
What's the role?

This role is responsible for driving the subscriber engagement and retention strategy across mastheads to achieve volume and revenue growth aspirations for our subscriptions business. Responsible for building an ‘engagement and retention engine’ that drives habitual connection, reduces churn and maximises customer lifetime value.

There will be a strong emphasis on driving app usage and digital product adoption, alongside TDD and operations. This role resides in the Engagement and Retention team within the Subscriptions Growth division at NCA.

This role is a 12 month contract and can be based at either our Surry Hills office in NSW or our Southbank office in VIC

Responsibilities:
- Support and execute the long-term subscription retention vision, focusing on building early healthy consumer habits (onboarding/reboarding) and supporting digital product launches to drive adoption.

- Design and run experimentation roadmaps, utilizing continuous A/B testing, data insights, and optimising the online cancellation journey UX to combat customer attrition and uncover growth opportunities.

- Identify high-risk churn segments to create and execute automated, personalised, and multi-channel targeted communication plans that build habitual subscriber connection.

- Partner closely with wider consumer marketing, editorial, technology, operations, and content teams to identify retention gaps and deliver cohesive go-to-market strategies.

- Closely monitor, optimise, and report on campaign performance, daily active trends, and attrition metrics to ensure all performance targets are met.

Who are you?
- Proven experience driving engagement, retention, and subscription growth through data-driven marketing, consumer strategies, and targeted contact plans.

- Strong financial literacy (P&L ownership) combined with data-driven problem-solving frameworks to translate complex data into bottom-line impact.

- Highly tech-savvy and detail-oriented, with hands-on proficiency in Miro, Salesforce, Adobe Analytics, and complex data sets.

- Adept at project management, mentoring team members, and managing diverse stakeholders with the ability to collaborate, evaluate, and challenge recommendations.

- A curious, creative, and customer-centric thinker who thrives in fast-paced environments, navigating challenges and Go-To-Market (GTM) opportunities with excellent communication skills.

- Own end-to-end audio product lifecycles, spanning from discovery and development through to launch, optimisation, and ongoing portfolio management, ensuring these dovetail with the broader branded content suite product roadmap and initiatives.
- Develop and maintain product documentation, specifications, commercial frameworks, and supporting materials.

jobs.description:
What's the role?
We are looking for an experienced technology and digital product leader with a strong commercial understanding to lead the technology strategy and delivery that supports our Client Product & Partnerships strategy.

As General Manager, Digital Product: Client Product & Partnerships , you will be the operating interface between Client Product, Client Partnerships and Technology within the Technology, Digital and Data function. You will translate commercial priorities into clear, prioritised and scalable technology delivery, leading the operating rhythm from opportunity through launch, optimisation and continuous improvement.

You will own technical delivery across a portfolio including video, commercial content, commercial data, ecommerce whilst incorporating advertising solutions,. You will ensure these capabilities integrate effectively with News Corp Australia’s audience proposition and create measurable value for audiences, advertisers and the business.

The role will lead dedicated web and app squads across product management, engineering, design and delivery. You will lead technology strategy, align priorities, remove barriers and create the conditions for high-quality execution across multiple initiatives. You will also mobilise capabilities across the wider Technology organisation when required.

AdTech does not sit within this function. However, you will work closely with the AdTech team and other technology partners to ensure strong alignment, effective integration and coordinated delivery across the broader commercial technology ecosystem.

Based in Technology, you will work closely with Client Product and Client Partnerships leadership, contribute insight and recommendations to strategic planning and investment decisions, and lead the technology response to agreed priorities. You will engage with executive leaders, clients and partners as required.

Success in this role will require experienced leadership, operating excellence, commercial judgement and the ability to turn complex priorities into focused plans, measurable outcomes and high-quality digital experiences.

What you will do
- Lead technology strategy: Develop and lead the technology strategy, priorities and delivery approach that support the Client Product & Partnerships strategy and agreed business outcomes.
- Lead technical delivery: Own the delivery of Client Product technology capabilities across advertising solutions, video, commercial content, commercial data propositions and ecommerce.
- Lead delivery teams: Lead dedicated web and app squads across product management, engineering, design and delivery, creating clarity, accountability and the conditions for high-quality execution.
- Connect commercial priorities with technology delivery: Translate Sales, Client Partnerships and Client Product priorities into clear technology plans, sequencing, dependencies and outcomes.
- Partner with AdTech: Work closely with the AdTech team and other technology partners to support alignment, integration and coordinated delivery, while recognising that AdTech sits outside this function.
- Integrate commercial and audience capabilities: Ensure commercial capabilities work effectively with the audience proposition, enhancing the consumer experience while meeting advertiser and business outcomes.
- Build and scale capability: Support the development and scaling of differentiated products, propositions, partnerships and technology-enabled services using data, technology and emerging capabilities.
- Establish delivery governance: Provide clear prioritisation, governance, delivery visibility, risk management and performance measures across the client delivery lifecycle.
- Contribute to investment decisions: Bring technology insight, delivery implications, options, risks and recommendations to investment discussions and planning processes.
- Drive cross-functional alignment: Manage and influence teams within and beyond direct reporting lines, aligning TDD, Client Partnerships, Client Product, AdTech and the wider business.
- Maintain an outside-in perspective: Monitor relevant innovation, technology advances and emerging practices across advertising, media and technology, translating useful opportunities into action.
- Contribute to strategic leadership: Participate in executive discussions and build strong relationships across News Corp to share best practice, leverage shared capabilities and support innovation at scale.

Who are you?
- Experienced leader: Significant leadership experience across technology, digital product, engineering, delivery or a related field, with a track record of leading complex, multi-disciplinary teams.
- Strong commercial understanding: The ability to understand commercial objectives, client needs, audience value and business performance, and translate them into practical technology priorities.
- Technology strategy and delivery experience: A proven track record of leading technology strategy and delivering complex, cross-functional initiatives from prioritisation through to execution and measurable impact.
- Portfolio leadership: Experience overseeing delivery across multiple products, platforms, capabilities or initiatives, ideally across web and app environments.
- Commercial product and partnership experience: Experience working at the intersection of digital product, commercial partnerships, advertising, media, ecommerce, data or technology-enabled services.
- AdTech and ecosystem awareness: Understanding of advertising technology and experience partnering effectively with AdTech or adjacent technology teams is preferred.
- Executive engagement: Experience working with senior executives, clients, partners and stakeholders across direct and indirect reporting lines.
- Investment and prioritisation experience: Experience contributing technology advice, options and recommendations to investment, prioritisation or planning decisions.
- Scaling capability: Experience building, launching or scaling products, propositions, partnerships, platforms or technology-enabled services.
- Collaborative leadership: The ability to lead through influence, build trust across organisational boundaries and operate as a pragmatic, outcome-focused leader.

Why News Corp Australia
Join a culture where innovation is our operating rhythm. You’ll work on a diverse portfolio of Australia’s most loved brands and play a pivotal role in leading the technological shift in how we create commercial content. Our vibrant, hybrid work environment and dynamic, values-driven culture empowers you to push boundaries, collaborate as one unified team, and make a positive, measurable impact for all Australians.
